Alquiler de trailers y equipo de remolque
Cajas y suministros de empaque (todos los tamanos, cinta, bolsas para colchon, mantas para muebles)
Renta one-way (una via) y en la ciudad
pricing_note: Tarifas fijadas por la red U-Haul, varian por fecha y disponibilidad. Una senaletica fotografiada en tienda mostraba 19.95 USD para rentas en la ciudad (promocion vigente al momento de la foto, no se presenta como precio fijo permanente).

reviews_verbatim.author: Stephen Ferriani
reviews_verbatim.text: Sean provided excellent customer service. I had an issue with a mistake on my order, and he quickly took care of it without any hassle. He also went out of his way to locate the correct equipment I needed at another location. Very professional, helpful, and easy to work with. Great guy and outstanding service!

reviews_verbatim.author: Freddie Gamboa
reviews_verbatim.text: This will be our go too for U-Haul trucks from now on. Shawn made it quick & super easy. Both my wife and I agreed that this has to have been our best experience ever in any U-Haul location. Thank you Shawn & Jason!

reviews_verbatim.author: Jaclyn Bachor
reviews_verbatim.text: Over the top customer service! These guys know what they are doing and are a delight to work with! Highly recommend them for all of your packing and moving needs!

reviews_verbatim.author: Jake Quin
reviews_verbatim.text: Amazing service by Shawn & Jason!!! Super easy to deal with!! I highly recommend this location.
